params.body:
## The defect

Clicking "Volgende" on the Foto's step of the Livewire vehicle sheet (which renders the Data step) crashed on staging with `Undefined variable $pSlug` in `ui/portal-icon`, for every dealer with portals.

## The cause

The `{{-- --}}` comment at the top of `resources/views/components/ui/portal-icon.blade.php` contained the literal word `@php` in a sentence. Blade extracts raw `@php ... @endphp` blocks before it strips comments (`BladeCompiler::storeUncompiledBlocks` runs ahead of `compileComments`), so the word in the comment became the start of the block and the real block with the assignments was emitted as text. Because the compiler wrote it as `<?php.` (no whitespace), PHP does not read it as an open tag: the compiled view lints clean, and `@if($pSlug ...)` reads a variable that was never set.

## The fix

One word in the comment, plus a warning in that comment not to name a directive there.

## The guards

- `CompiledViewsTest::test_no_blade_directive_survives_compilation_as_text`: compiles every view and fails when a directive is still present as literal text. It matches the directive shape (`@php`, `@endphp`, `@endif`, ... as a word; `@if(`, `@foreach(`, `@json(`, ... with a parenthesis; `{{ ` and `{!! `), not a bare `@`, so e-mail addresses and JavaScript stay out. Excluded: PHP blocks in the compiled output (`<?php ` or `<?=` up to `?>`), and echo tags in views whose source carries the `@{{` escape (four offerte views do that on an img-src, which looks suspicious but is outside this PR). Verified that it fails on origin/main with exactly `portal-icon.blade.php: @php` and passes on this branch.
- `VehicleFormPortalIconTest`: renders the Data step for a dealer with a portal without a favicon (monogram) and one with (`autoscout24be`). Reproduces the staging exception on origin/main.
- The existing `php -l` pass over every compiled view already lived in `CompiledViewsTest`; it is kept as is.

Both guards over the whole tree flag nothing else.

## Docs

X-125 in `docs/bedrijfsregels/90-x-bevindingen.md`.

## Tests

`vendor/bin/phpunit --filter='VehicleForm|Portal|CompiledViews|BladeCompiles|AlpineExpression|StylesheetSyntax|RulesCoverage'`: OK (29 tests, 729 assertions), plus the new test.
